intel_governance.title: AI governance
intel_governance.subtitle: What the intelligence did, which model did it, how well it performs, and what may run without a person.
intel_governance.playbook_steps_hint: The playbook's steps, as they stood when it was applied. Each is done by a person.
intel_governance.violation: {user} is a service account and holds approval grants it must not have: {perms}.

status_banner.PARTIAL: Some intelligence is out of date.
status_banner.hint: {n} component(s) affected. Missing intelligence is not evidence that there is no risk; deterministic controls keep running.

class_hint.1: Summaries, explanations, detections and predictions. Produced automatically within the user's data scope.
class_hint.2: Drafts and simulations: purchase requests, schedule proposals, maintenance requests, corrective plans. Prepared automatically, committed only after approval.
class_hint.3: Operationally sensitive actions. The AI never carries these out; the recommendation points to the existing workflow, with its own approvals.

intel_governance.sensitive_kinds: Operationally sensitive action kinds (no executor may exist for them)
intel_governance.failsafe: When an agent, feed or the language model is unavailable, the manufacturing engine and its deterministic controls carry on; nothing is estimated in place of a missing measurement.
intel_governance.audit_needs: Reading the AI audit trail needs the AI audit permission.
intel_governance.four_eyes_models: A version is backtested, then deployed by somebody other than the person who prepared it. Rolling back redeploys the previous version.
intel_governance.evaluation: {v} confirmed, {d} dismissed, {o} open, {miss} incident(s) not predicted
intel_governance.rules_only: No versions yet: records carry the agent's rules version.
intel_governance.name: Name
intel_governance.rules_hint: An event becomes an alert when its category is on, it touches a registered dependency (if required), its severity or exposure meets the threshold, and its source is known.
intel_governance.baseline_hint: No benefit is claimed without a baseline recorded before the change; with too little data the benefit is reported as not yet measurable.

alerts.title: External alerts
alerts.subtitle: External events that touch your factories, suppliers, materials or orders, with their source, confidence and the response under way.
alerts.steps_on_case: Steps are completed on the case.
